question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā operate up to Māyā?
premises: Action extends up to Māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, operates up to the limit of Māyā.
uncertainties: The precise verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, reaches up to Māyā.
